semantics: Hypothetical fixed current-equivalent quantities held throughout available history, in EUR; no daily weight rebalancing, trading, cash flows, fees or separately paid dividends. Forward fill only after genuine inception; latest missing US/NAV observations are carried at their last published value. Benchmarks end at their own genuine last session; EUR conversion uses dated ECB USD/EUR. Risk-free/target return zero,252 sessions/year. Full-history in-sample description, not realised account performance or an out-of-sample test. netSD uses all72 unchanged asset references plus this candidate once, recomputes the augmented-network maximum degree and excludes no diagnostic segment here. Retrospective regime labels are never forward-filled.

hypotheses_coverage.definition: Saved initial hypothetical compositions: published model versions, regime fits, completed rolling-origin refits and provenance-matched reduction repeats. Duplicate quantities are evaluated once. Unsaved optimiser proposals and frontier points without recoverable holdings are not invented. Future adaptive trades are not converted into an initial buy-and-hold composition.
